title: Cake pickup after work near Clyde or Rosehill? Harris Park is open till 10pm
summary:
Finish at 6 and every bakery near Clyde, Rosehill or Camellia has already shut? Harris Park opens 11am to 10pm, 7 days a week.

Order a 100% eggless custom cake two days ahead, then collect it on your way home from Wigram Street, a short walk from Harris Park station. 6-inch from $39.99, 8-inch from $49.99. No eggs. No extra questions at the counter.

Send your design on WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725.
